description: Open the Exam Anxiety dataset (already loaded). Perform an Analysis of Covariance (ANCOVA) to determine the effect of Gender on Exam performance, controlling for Anxiety. Navigate to 'Analyses > ANOVA > ANCOVA'. Set 'Exam' as the Dependent Variable, 'Gender' as the Fixed Factor, and 'Anxiety' as the Covariate. Under 'Assumption Checks', enable the 'Homogeneity test' (Levene's). Under 'Estimated Marginal Means', add 'Gender' to the terms list. Under 'Effect Size', enable 'partial eta-squared' (η²p). Finally, save the completed analysis to '/home/ga/Documents/Jamovi/ExamAnxiety_ANCOVA.omv'.
